evals.prompt: 请把这篇文章改写成一篇中文博客并生成封面，然后发布到微信公众号草稿箱：https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
evals.expected_output: 会先用 Chrome DevTools MCP 抓取正文并形成结构化笔记，再生成中文 Markdown 博客。封面阶段默认读取 `references/cover-prompt-template.md`，创建 `src/assets/{ID}/cover-brief.json`，先把文章压成单张宽封面的 infographic storytelling summary：记录 `summary_angle`、`narrative_flow`、`information_blocks`、`comic_style` 和 `comic_style_reason`，优先调用 `imagegen` 生成宽封面，把最终选中图保存为 `src/assets/{ID}/01-cover.{ext}`，并把 `ogImage` 与 `wechat-draft` 的 `cover-image` 都指向这个最终实际路径。

assertions.text: Cover generation uses `imagegen` as the default backend, not `azure-image-gen`.
The workflow creates or describes a cover brief before writing the final image prompt.
The cover brief records an infographic-summary structure including `summary_angle`, `narrative_flow`, `information_blocks`, `comic_style`, and `comic_style_reason`.
The final cover image is saved under `src/assets/{ID}/` rather than left in a generated-images temp/default directory.
`ogImage` and the WeChat `cover-image` parameter reference the final cover path.

evals.prompt: 把这个产品发布页写成中文博客，封面用默认方式生成，不要做成产品截图：https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-image-2/
evals.expected_output: 会把文章类型识别为产品更新 / 发布型，封面 brief 中选择 `release`，并在用户未指定风格时自动选择 `japanese-manga`。封面最终风格明确落在日漫或美漫之一，这里是日漫；封面不是泛主题插画，而是单张宽封面的 infographic summary：用 `2-4` 个来源可追溯的信息块概括发布重点，文字默认只保留 `1-3` 处少量中文短标签或数字，但仍然禁止主标题、假 UI、假 dashboard、假图表和假终端。

assertions.text: The cover type is selected from the fixed taxonomy and is appropriate for a product/release article.
When comic style is unspecified for a `release` article, the brief auto-selects `japanese-manga` and records the reason.
The image prompt keeps visible text to a small amount of source-grounded Chinese labels or numbers by default, not poster titles or long caption text.
The cover concept expresses the article theme without pretending to be a real product screenshot.

evals.prompt: 请用 Azure OpenAI 生成封面，把这篇英文教程改写成中文博客并推到微信草稿箱，封面用美漫信息图风格：https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/dall-e
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确指定 Azure 和美漫风格的要求，在封面阶段走 `azure-image-gen` 回退路径，并把 `comic_style` 设为 `american-comic`。仍然先生成 `cover-brief.json`，按模板构造单张宽封面的 infographic-story prompt，并把 Azure 脚本最终输出的实际文件路径（可能是 `.png`、`.jpg` 或 `.webp`）同步到 Markdown `ogImage` 和 `wechat-draft` 的 `cover-image`。

assertions.text: Explicit Azure preference overrides the default `imagegen` backend.
An explicit comic-style request overrides the auto-selection rule.
The Azure final output path extension is treated as authoritative.
The final image path is propagated consistently to blog frontmatter and WeChat publishing.

evals.prompt: 把这篇架构文章写成中文博客。封面可以参考正文里的架构图，但不能照抄，也不能生成假的架构标签：https://example.com/agent-workflow-architecture
evals.expected_output: 会把文章类型识别为架构 / 系统设计。如果文章主线是工作流 / pipeline / 分层展开，封面 brief 会在未指定风格时自动选择 `japanese-manga`，并用 `2-4` 个来源可追溯的信息块把流程压成单张宽封面；最终风格明确是日漫分镜，文字只保留少量中文步骤标签，但仍然禁止假架构节点名、假 dashboard、假图表坐标和 screenshot 风格。

assertions.text: Reference images are used only for composition or subject relationships, not pixel-level copying.
For workflow-style `architecture` articles, the brief auto-selects `japanese-manga` and records the reason.
Architecture covers may show abstract connections and flow markers but must not create fake labeled system diagrams.
The prompt includes a clear avoid list for fake labels and screenshot-like artifacts.

evals.prompt: 只把这个链接写成博客，不要生成封面，也不要发微信：https://example.com/short-note
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确的范围限制：仍然抓取 URL、生成中文 Markdown、写入 frontmatter 和参考链接，但跳过 `imagegen` / `azure-image-gen` 封面生成，不写 `ogImage`，也不调用 `wechat-draft`。

assertions.text: The explicit no-cover request prevents any image generation backend from being invoked.
The explicit no-WeChat request prevents `wechat-draft` from being invoked.
The blog article is still generated normally without `ogImage`.

evals.prompt: 把这篇观点文章改写成中文博客并生成封面：https://example.com/spec-driven-ai-opinion
evals.expected_output: 会把文章识别为 `analysis`，在用户未指定风格时自动选择 `american-comic`，并把封面做成单张宽封面的 infographic storytelling summary：至少压出 `2` 个能映射回原文的叙事信息块，而不是只画一张泛技术氛围图。

assertions.text: When comic style is unspecified for an `analysis` article, the brief auto-selects `american-comic` and records the reason.
The cover summary contains at least two article-grounded information blocks rather than a generic thematic illustration.
The prompt forbids poster titles, fake UI labels, fake chart axes, and fabricated metrics even when comic styling is used.

evals.prompt: 把这篇研究解读写成中文博客，封面指定日漫分镜信息图风格，并保留一两个关键数字：https://example.com/model-paper-breakdown
evals.expected_output: 会把文章识别为 `research`，但尊重用户明确指定的日漫分镜信息图要求，把 `comic_style` 设为 `japanese-manga`。封面仍保持单张宽图，最终风格明确落在日漫；只允许少量来源可追溯的中文短标签和关键数字，不能扩展成海报式长标题或伪造实验图表。

assertions.text: An explicit `japanese-manga` request overrides the default auto-selection for a `research` article.
Visible numbers on the cover must be sourced from the article or used as ordinal markers, not invented.
The prompt allows only a small amount of Chinese labels and key numbers while still forbidding long titles and fake charts.
